The '''Celebratus Archive''' was a [[Library/Legends|library]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] that held complete records from over three hundred thousand different [[Species/Legends|species]]. The creation of the library, in [[16,782 BBY]], secured the reputation of the planet as a bastion of research. The archive was included in the list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the historian [[Vicendi]] in his [[10,000 BBY]] publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="EA" />

The library was [[Obroa-skai information raid|raided]] by forces under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in order to uncover the location of the planet [[Myrkr/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="HtE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
